title: Find the names of all mythic rarity cards that are banned in the Legacy for
question: Find the names of all mythic rarity cards that are banned in the Legacy format and belong to sets that have a Japanese translation.

prediction.sql:
SELECT T1."XCL_049"
FROM cards AS T1
INNER JOIN legalities AS T2 ON T1."XCL_072" = T2."XCL_086"
INNER JOIN set_translations AS T3 ON T1."XCL_063" = T3."XCL_093"
WHERE T1."XCL_059" = 'mythic'
  AND T2."XCL_084" = 'legacy'
  AND T2."XCL_085" = 'Banned'
  AND T3."XCL_092" = 'Japanese'
